stories.title: QB3 Case Keenum, Bears defense shock Eagles in MNF rout
stories.summary: Keenum stepped up big in a pressure situation and combined with a defensive gem to lead the Bears past the Eagles.

stories.title: Senate greenlights Protect College Sports Act with 77-22 vote
stories.summary: The Protect College Sports Act, a federal bill aimed at reshaping the industry, took a step toward to becoming law Monday when the U.S. Senate voted 77-22 to pass it, with Ted Cruz saying, "This bill puts an end to the chaos plaguing college athletics."

stories.title: Sirianni rues reaction to flagged hit on Hurts in Eagles' MNF loss
stories.summary: After a 27-7 loss to Chicago on Monday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni expressed "remorse" over his reaction to a sideline hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson on Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts that temporarily knocked his quarterback out of the first half.

stories.title: Giants trade for Vikings QB McCarthy, but say Winston remains QB1
stories.summary: The Giants are trading for Vikings quarterback J.J. McCarthy, sending a 2027 fifth-round draft pick to Minnesota for the 2024 first-round pick.

stories.title: Harbaugh offers rare critique of struggling QB Herbert: 'Be better'
stories.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh offered a rare public critique of Justin Herbert on Monday, imploring the quarterback to "be better."
